title: 2026 Canyons by UTMB 100k Results: Adam Peterman and Riley Brady Take Home Wins — iRunFar
claims: The 2026 Canyons 100K had a late reroute earlier in race week because of inclement weather; runners still faced about 12,300 ft of gain and 17,000 ft of descent.
The 2026 race was the 12th edition and nearly 700 runners started at China Wall at 05:00.
In the men's race Peterman won in 8:18:47, Miller was second in 8:21:05, Hawks third in 8:23:28 and Can-Hua Luo fourth in 8:25:17.

In the women's race Brady won in 9:41:09, Arnold was second in 9:56:36 and Allaben third in 10:14:58; Arnold and Allaben declined their Golden Tickets, which rolled to Sarah Humble (4th, 10:18:43) and Ellaney Matarese (5th, 10:29:16).
